title: THE INVERTED-PIE READING: dust inside, phantom outside -- the physical interpretation of the corrected cluster pie, the galaxy-cluster unity, and the self-consistency of the 82%-at-50-kpc dust share
context: G179 (the corrected pie: dust 82% at 50 kpc -> 25% at R500, phantom 2% -> 57%; the temperature faces); G098 (the f_dust profile: inner 0.75-0.86, floor-A vs equipartition); G119/G072 (the MW: r_M 10.21, kernel r_cut 6.13 = 0.62 r_M, R_efe 6.74 = 0.66 r_M, the deep law's closure 0.145 dex zero parameters); G164 (the break band 6.1-6.74, step +0.22 at 3.07 sigma); G095/G135 (the temperature law T_obs/T_pred = 2 f r_M/r, f_median 5.66, u 0.315, data-pie face 0.057 dex)

gates.name: G0a [G179 gate] the corrected radial pie rows and the R500 medians reproduced from G179_results.json
gates.measured: 50 kpc dust 81.6% / phantom 2.0%; R500 phantom 56.9% / dust 24.6%
gates.reading: the pie being interpreted is G179's committed one -- dust 82% at 50 kpc, phantom 57% at R500, the correction's own numbers

gates.name: G0b [G098 gate] the f_dust profile's inner end reproduced: f_dust at 0.2 R500 median + range; cumulative F_A at 0.2/1.0 R500
gates.reading: G098's committed inner dust share (0.75-0.86 of the MISSING mass at 0.2-0.5 R500) -- the number the 82%-at-50-kpc pie share must reconcile with

gates.name: G0c [G119 gate] the MW anchors reproduced: r_M, the kernel r_cut 6.13 = 0.623 r_M, R_efe 6.74 = 0.66 r_M
gates.reading: the deep-law regime at galaxy scale is [r_in, R_efe] = [0.30, 0.66] r_M -- entirely INSIDE r_M: the phantom occupies the interior

gates.name: G0d [G072 gate] the MW interior closes with the phantom alone (zero free dust): v_c(R0) phantom face and the curve at 6 kpc
gates.measured: v_ph-face(R0) = 223.9 vs 232.5 (-3.7%); at 6 kpc v_pred = 226.6 vs Eilers 230.8
gates.reading: the deep law v_flat^2(1 - r_in/R) reproduces the MW interior to ~2-4% with the phantom ONLY -- at galaxy scale the interior missing mass is the phantom, not the dust (G071: 0.145 dex, zero parameters)

gates.name: G0e [G164 gate] the galaxy-scale break: step +0.22 beta units at 3.07 sigma, peak 6.33 kpc in the 6.1-6.74 band (= r_M x 0.60-0.66)
gates.measured: step = +0.22 at 3.07 sigma; peak 6.33 kpc in [6.1, 6.74]
gates.reading: the measured transition sits at the EFE line: the deep law's outer edge is measured, and it is at ~0.6 r_M -- inside r_M

gates.name: G0f [G179 T-gate] the temperature cross-check faces reproduced: data-pie face 0.057 dex (HSE 0.053), 2/3-law face 0.067 dex
gates.measured: data-pie log10 rms = 0.057 dex; 2/3-law rms = 0.067 dex
gates.reading: the pie's implied temperature closes at the HSE level on the TOTAL face: T_vir(M500) sees the whole pie

gates.name: P1 [the field gate] the pie's sector boundary sits at the field's a0-crossing: g_tot(R500)/a0 < 1 (12/12 -- the phantom-dominated radius is deep-regime), r_M is the baryonic a0-crossing by construction (G M_b/r_M^2 = a0, the Lean-certified identity, r_M inside the dust-dominated window), and the dynamical a0-crossing estimate r_a0(iso) ~ x_dp (the committed dust/phantom crossover)
gates.measured: g(R500)/a0 median 0.554 < 1 (12/12); r_a0(iso)/R500 median 0.554 vs x_dp median 0.410 (delta +0.144)
gates.reading: at R500 (phantom 57%) the total field is below a0 -- the phantom zone IS the deep regime; inside r_M (baryonic a0-crossing, by construction) the field is sup-a0 -- the dust-dominated window is the strong-field core; the dynamical crossing and the committed dust/phantom crossover coincide to within the isothermal estimate

gates.name: P2 [the '98% of the interior' resolves at cluster scale] the pie's 82%-at-50-kpc dust share of M_DYN is 0.976 of the MISSING mass at 50 kpc (s_d/(1-s_b)) -- the '98%' is dust's share of the interior missing mass
gates.reading: approximately 98% of the interior missing mass at 50 kpc is free dust: THE '98%-of-the-interior' CLAIM IS A CLUSTER-SCALE READING (the pie's dust share renormalized to the missing mass) -- and it is the GALAXY scale where the check flips (Part 2)

gates.name: P3 [(b) the temperature law reads the TOTAL] the virial T is set by the total mass: T_pie = T_vir(M500) at 0.057 dex; the 2/3-law face uses f = M_dyn/M_b = the pie's TOTAL ratio; the dust's 24.6% enters through the potential (~0.13 dex of T_vir), not as a thermal phase
gates.measured: f = 5.66; closed form 3.56 (committed 3.512); dust's T contribution +0.127 dex via M_dyn
gates.reading: the phantom's 57% at R500 is what the temperature 'sees' (it is the equilibrated sector at the virial temperature; T_obs/T_pred = 2f r_M/r is fixed by the TOTAL f); the dust contributes through the potential well (M_dyn in T_vir), consistent with the dust being the cold un-equilibrated sector (G098/G093)

gates.name: Q1 [the galaxy interior IS the phantom] at the solar circle the interior missing mass is the phantom: with the committed capped phantom form the dust is ~0-5% of M_dyn (the deep law closes the deficit, G072/G071), and even the uncapped equipartition face leaves dust at <= 15% -- the galaxy interior is NOT 98% dust
gates.measured: solar circle: dust(capped) = 4.27%, dust(equip) = 0.00%, phantom share of the dark = 0.89, f = 1.65
gates.reading: the '98% of the interior missing mass is dust' figure is INVERTED at galaxy scale: the MW interior dark sector is ~85-95% phantom (the r^-2 profile, the deep law) with ~0-5% dust -- the same two-regime law read in the equilibrium-formed regime

gates.name: Q2 [the flip is not a window artifact] at matched r/r_M = 0.6 the sectors flip between the scales: galaxy dust ~0-10% (phantom interior) vs cluster dust ~74-79% (dust interior), with the phantom's share of the DARK mass ~90% at the galaxy and ~10-15% at the cluster
gates.measured: y = 0.6: galaxy s_d = 0.039 vs cluster s_d = 0.789-0.740
gates.reading: the two pies are the same two-regime law viewed at different r/r_M windows, AND the equilibration boundary sits inside r_M at galaxy scale (the EFE line at 0.66 r_M) but outside it at cluster scale (phantom > dust only beyond ~1.3 r_M)

gates.name: Q3 [the mechanism] the phantom's equilibrium covers the deficit with share (r/r_M)/(f-1): ~1 at the galaxy solar circle (f ~ 1.9), 0.03 at the cluster's 50 kpc (f ~ 5.7), ~0.7-1 at R500 -- the dust fills the gap where the equilibrium cannot (the strong-field core) and the phantom wins where it can
gates.measured: coverage: galaxy R0 1.23, cluster 50 kpc 0.027, cluster R500 0.68
gates.reading: the deficit ratio f = M_dyn/M_b is the switch: at galaxy scale f ~ 1.9 (the phantom closes it, zero dust); at cluster scale f ~ 5.7 (the equilibrium's linear growth cannot, and the interior deficit is dust ~97-98%)

gates.name: Q4 [the break is the deep law's END] the MW's 6.13 kpc break sits INSIDE r_M (0.60 r_M) at the EFE line R_efe = 0.66 r_M -- the deep regime OCCUPIES the galaxy interior, so the galaxy pie reads phantom-inside / dust-outside, the mirror of the cluster pie
gates.measured: break = 6.13 kpc = 0.601 r_M; R_efe = 6.74 = 0.660 r_M (both < r_M)
gates.reading: the two pies are the same two-regime law in r/r_M: galaxy window [0.5, 2.4] r_M shows the phantom zone's interior; cluster window [0.13, 3.2] r_M shows the strong-field core -> crossover -> deep regime, with the phantom dominant only at/outside R500

gates.name: S1 [the 82% and the 0.75-0.86 are the same number] the pie's 82%-at-50-kpc share of M_dyn is 0.976 of the missing mass there; G098's inner f_dust (0.75-0.86 at 0.2-0.5 R500) is the same ratio at larger radii, falling outward -- consistent within the window shift and the phantom-floor convention
gates.measured: 50 kpc: 81.6% of total = 97.6% of missing; G098: 0.78 at 0.2 R500; R500: 0.55 cumulative
gates.reading: the two readings of the same truth: dust dominates the inner missing mass (~75-98%), declining outward; the pie's 0.82 and G098's 0.75-0.86 differ only in the unit convention (share of M_dyn vs share of the missing mass) and the radius (50 kpc vs 0.2-0.5 R500)

gates.name: S2 [the convention residual is registered] the two faces agree to within the phantom-floor convention (0.90 vs 0.78-0.82 at 0.2 R500, the G179-registered equipartition-vs-floor-A spread)
gates.measured: pie equipartition dust/missing @210 kpc = 0.91 vs G098 floor-A @0.2 R500 = 0.82
gates.reading: not a discrepancy: the pie uses the equipartition phantom (M_b r/r_M), G098 uses the density-integral floor (35% at R500); both say the inner missing mass is dust, at the ~78-98% level

gates.name: V1 [the clean two-regime reading]
gates.measured: 81.6% dust at 50 kpc (=97.6% of the missing mass), 56.9% phantom at R500; r_a0 = 0.55 R500, g(R500)/a0 = 0.55
gates.reading: THE PIE IS THE TWO-REGIME MAP (the clean reading): at cluster scale the free dust dominates the inner volume -- 81.6% of M_dyn at 50 kpc (97.6% of the missing mass there), falling to 24.6% at R500 -- and the phantom dominates at/outside R500 (2.0% at 50 kpc rising to 56.9%).  The phantom is deep-regime physics: the equilibrium phase forms where the field is below the a0-class and the un-equilibrated dust carries the strong-field core.  The field check: g_tot(R500)/a0 = 0.55 < 1 on 12/12 clusters (the phantom-dominated radius is sub-a0); r_M is the baryonic a0-crossing by construction (G M_b/r_M^2 = a0, the Lean-certified identity) with r_M = 402 kpc = 0.31 R500 inside the dust-dominated window; the dynamical a0-crossing estimate r_a0(iso) = 0.55 R500 coincides with the committed dust/phantom crossover x_dp = 0.41 R500: the dust-dominated window (s_d 66-82% for r < 0.5 R500) is the sup-a0 strong-field core, the phantom-dominated zone (57% at R500) is sub-a0 -- the sector bookkeeping IS the two-regime map.  THE '98% OF THE INTERIOR (missing mass)' IS THIS: 97.6% dust at 50 kpc.

gates.name: V2 [the galaxy-cluster unity]
gates.measured: MW interior phantom share of dark = 0.89, s_d = 0.04; cluster interior s_d = 0.82
gates.reading: THE GALAXY-CLUSTER UNITY: the two pies are the SAME two-regime law viewed at different r/r_M windows -- with the equilibration boundary's POSITION inside r_M at galaxy scale and outside it at cluster scale.  At the MW: the deep-law phantom regime is [0.30, 0.66] r_M (r_in = 3.06 kpc to the EFE line R_efe = 6.74 kpc), entirely INSIDE r_M = 10.21 kpc; the interior missing mass is the phantom (the r^-2 profile: the solar-circle dark fraction 0.40 is 0.89 phantom, dust 4.27%, the deep law closing the RC to ~2-4%, G072/G071), and the break at 6.13 kpc = 0.601 r_M is where the deep law ENDS (the EFE hand-off, measured: G164 step +0.22, 3.07 sigma), NOT where it begins.  At the clusters: r_M = 0.31 R500, the phantom exceeds the dust only beyond ~1.3 r_M and dominates at/outside R500 (56.9%), while the strong-field core is dust (81.6% at 50 kpc).  The mechanism is the deficit ratio: the equilibrium phantom covers share (r/r_M)/(f-1) of the deficit -- ~1 at the galaxy solar circle (f = 1.65), 0.03 at the cluster 50 kpc (f = 5.7) -- so the galaxy interior equilibrates and the cluster interior does not.  At matched r/r_M = 0.6 the sectors flip: galaxy dust 0.04 vs cluster dust 0.79-0.74.

gates.name: V3 [the honest statement]
gates.measured: 98% -> cluster interior missing-mass dust at 50 kpc; galaxy interior = phantom (dark share 0.89)
gates.reading: HONEST: the corrected pie is the two-regime map stated ONCE at both scales, with the numbers: at the cluster, dust 82% of M_dyn at 50 kpc (98% of the missing mass) -> 57% phantom at R500; at the galaxy, the interior missing mass is ~89% phantom (dust 4% at the solar circle) and the break is the deep law's end at 0.60 r_M.  The '98% of the interior' figure is the CLUSTER's dust share of the interior missing mass -- NOT a galaxy statement (there it is the phantom, and the brief's 'phantom-dominated inside r_M' framing was inverted by the pie at BOTH scales into the correct sector by sector).  The residual honesty register: the pie's 82% and G098's 0.75-0.86 are the same number in two unit conventions plus the phantom-floor convention (equipartition vs floor-A, the G179-registered 57%/35% spread); the galaxy-side dust floor-dependent at the ~5-15% level (the uncapped equipartition face even overshoots at the solar circle, mirroring A2319's negative dust at the cluster end); and the field gate uses the exact committed anchors (g(R500)/a0 from M500/R500, r_M as the baryonic a0-crossing by construction, the isothermal dynamical-crossing estimate vs the committed x_dp) -- the rho-integral route was rejected because the committed density arrays start at 0.1 R500 and cannot contain the central cusp.
